general_information.Description: This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Investment Management Specialization", it will help students understand how investment strategies are designed to reach financial goals in a global context. You will learn the theory that underlies strong investment decisions, as well as practical, real-world skills that you can apply when discussing investment proposals with your advisor, managing your personal assets or your client’s investment portfolio. Students will then learn how to adequately build and manage a portfolio with a long-term view while gaining an appreciation for novel research advances in finance and related areas as well as future trends that are shaping the investment management industry. *Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by the instructor after class - Use laptop in class only for learning purposes - Access FU FLM for up-to-date course information https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/

Students will then learn how to adequately build and manage a portfolio with a long-term view while gaining an appreciation for novel research advances in finance and related areas as well as future trends that are shaping the investment management industry. *Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate basic understanding of financial markets, fixed income securities and other markets such as gold, real estate, hedge funds and private markets.
Understand the central banks policies and the impact on financial markets
Understand the link between cognitive biases, emotions and moral values and investment decisions
Understand the concept of efficient market hypothesis and behaviral finance theory
Demonstrate basic understanding of building porfolio methodologies
Understand the relationship between risk and return in building a investment portfolio
Apply key risk management tools to hedge market and currency risks
Demonstrate basic understanding of evaluating investment performance methods
Apply key models to measure investment performance
Demonstrate the ability to produce an appropriate wealth plan for clients

assessments.Note: Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, group discussion

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test students' ability to understand and apply the skills and knowledge of the delivered units
assessments.Grading Guide: Complete the Case study assignment according to the instructions and data on Coursera, as well as teacher's guide. Then, submit the work to the instructor to be graded. Example: "Planning your Client's Wealth over a 5-year Horizon"
assessments.Note: Students are divided into groups of up to 5 people to work on a real-life case study (selected by the students and approved by the instructor)

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Progress test 1 (10%): LO1->LO2; Progress test 2 (15%): LO3->LO7; Progress test 3 (10%):LO8,9
assessments.Note: Teacher is allowed to select which unit content (topic or learning outcome) to focus on each examination session. The questions are based on the Coursera quizzes.
Participation grade will be given based on students' preparation, quantity as well as group performance
